run_fill_performance_benchmark_plot: run the script with JSON benchmark files to generate a fill performance comparison SVG chart
parse_benchmark_json_data: parse Google Benchmark JSON output files to extract CPU times, dimensions, and distribution tags
normalize_cpu_cycles: convert benchmark nanosecond times to average CPU cycles per random input value using CPU frequency
generate_horizontal_bar_chart: generate a matplotlib horizontal bar chart comparing histogram fill performance across implementations like ROOT, NumPy, and GSL
save_performance_svg: save the fill performance comparison chart as an SVG file named fill_performance.svg
